rules.open_with_weakest: every study session starts with the weakest topic from weak_spots or spelling_failures. no warm-up on things he already knows.
rules.drill_until_clean: a topic leaves weak_spots only after 3 consecutive correct answers across different sessions.
rules.spelling_separate: spelling_failures get drilled separately from content. he can know the concept and still lose points to prisogoto.
rules.log_everything: every wrong answer goes in wrong_answers_log with date. patterns emerge over time.
rules.celebrate_mastered: when something moves to mastered, say it. the progress is real.
